value.title: Telegram media: send files from pij-rs (photo, video, animation, document)
value.summary: Restore the never-merged PR #49 (Telegram documents from pij-rs) and extend it: method by file type with a sendDocument fallback, several files per send, a body with files, token redaction proof, and no more silent drop of inbound media.

sections.name: summary
sections.value: Vaughan, 27 Oct: pij-rs cannot send files to Telegram, which is 'stupid'; 'I thought it did'. The deep look (2026-10-27) found it did, briefly: PR #49 (ce2721d) added `pij-rs sidecar telegram --file` and `pij send pij-telegram --file` as Telegram documents, was green in CI and live-canaried on this machine, but was never reviewed or merged, so later bounces from main dropped it. It is 100 commits behind with one doc conflict. Main is text-only (docs/how/pij-telegram.md says so), the shim refuses --file, and inbound media from Vaughan is discarded with no event. The old TS bridge (pij-poc e5dd811) sent photos/animations/documents by extension and saved inbound media to the session's attachments dir. This plan restores #49 and closes the gaps the brief names. Prime rulings: assets/rulings.md.

sections.name: goals
value: An agent can hand Vaughan an image, video, GIF or any file through pij, and it arrives as the right kind of Telegram message.
Nothing is dropped silently, in either direction.
The bot token can never leak through the media path.

sections.name: non_goals
value: Deploying: no relink, daemon restart, extension reload, or live canary without Vaughan's go.
Saving inbound media to disk (follow-up issue, ac-0008).
sendMediaGroup albums: they cannot mix documents with photos/videos and prevent per-file fallback.
Several files through the `pij send` shim; it stays one --file, no body, as #49 shipped it.
Retention of staged copies after a terminal failure (#49 keeps them; noted for the follow-up).

value.claim: Restore #49. Commit ce2721d (pij-fleet#49, Vaughan Knight, 13 Oct) is cherry-picked onto main 26fc3ba with its authorship and trailers kept; the one textual conflict (docs/how/pij-rs-api.md) is resolved keeping main's watchdog line and #49's --file line; #49's own tests (sidecar telegram_document_tests, daemon shim_http, CLI sidecar_producer, arch_drift) pass on the new base.

Method by type. Staging classifies each file by its lower-cased extension and size, and the job records the method: jpg/jpeg/png/webp up to 10 MB -> sendPhoto (field `photo`); a larger image -> sendDocument; mp4 -> sendVideo (field `video`); gif -> sendAnimation (field `animation`, ruling Q2); anything else -> sendDocument. When sendPhoto, sendVideo or sendAnimation answers HTTP 400, the same attempt re-sends the same staged bytes with sendDocument; the 400 is recorded as telegram.outbound-delivery-failed carrying `method` and `fallback: sendDocument`. A delivered file appends telegram.outbound-media-delivered with the method used, file name, size and sha256.

Several files. `pij-rs sidecar telegram --file

[--file

...]` accepts up to 10 files. The daemon stages every file before queueing any; if one is refused, nothing is queued and copies already staged are removed. Each file is its own job (per-file outcome in pij.sqlite; a retry never resends a delivered file), queued in argument order on the chat's serial key, so they arrive in order. With one file and no body the file keeps the request msg_id; otherwise file n uses `#`. --caption goes on the first file; every file's caption carries the [sender] tag.

Body with files. --body or --body-file may be combined with --file. The body is queued first as an ordinary text send (same prefix, chunking and failure events as today), then the files. Without --file the text path is unchanged.

Refuse before sending. The CLI resolves each --file to an absolute path and fails on a missing one; the daemon re-checks and refuses, before anything is queued: a missing, unreadable, empty or non-regular file; a file over 50 MB (52,428,800 bytes); a caption over 1024 characters behind the sender tag; a relative path; more than 10 files. Job payloads record the source path, staged path, file name, size, sha256 and method, never the bytes.

Redaction. The bot token never appears in a job payload, a job's failure outcome, a spine event, or the error the worker logs, on any media path: transport failure, HTTP error status, ok=false, and the 400 fallback. The token is never on the CLI's argv (it lives only in the daemon's credential file). Proved with a sentinel token against a fake Bot API, plus a mutant that formats the raw reqwest error.

Inbound media is not dropped silently (ruling Q3b). Today handle_update ignores any message without text, caption included. An allowed user's photo, document, video, animation, audio, voice, video_note or sticker is now delivered to the bound seat as a text turn: `[telegram media not saved by pij-rs: <kind>, <size>, <file name>] caption: <caption>`, and appends telegram.inbound-media-unsupported (update_id, conversation, kind, size, file name, msg_id). With no binding it is refused exactly as text is. Text handling is unchanged.

Docs and follow-up. docs/how/pij-telegram.md documents methods, fallback, several files, body with files, limits, events and the inbound notice; docs/how/pij-rs-api.md and skills/pij/references/routes/peer.md match. A follow-up issue for inbound save-to-path cites the old TS design (pij-poc e5dd811 telegram/media.ts: 20 MB getFile pre-check, sanitised single-segment names, per-seat attachments dir, 200 MB retention, oldest first, never the new file).

Proof. Every new behaviour has a test shown RED on 7800d11 (the cherry-pick) and green on the branch. Mutation receipts, one at a time, each red then restored: the 50 MB check, the caption limit, the stage-all-before-queue rule, the 400 fallback, and the token redaction. cargo fmt, clippy -D warnings, the scoped cargo tests and `harness checks` pass (anything not run is NOT RUN with its reason); GitHub CI green on the exact head; the PR references #49 and #49 carries a comment asking to close it on merge. No deploy, relink, daemon restart, extension reload or live canary (that needs Vaughan's go).

value.title: Restore #49 and extend outbound media
value.brief: One phase: cherry-pick ce2721d, RED tests, method by type with fallback, several files and body, redaction proof, inbound notice, docs, follow-up issue, mutants, gates, PR. CS 3.
